title: Shwetha Nagara
desc: Madhumati ventures into the Nallamala Forest to procure an ancient book written by priests. Later, she encounters a shape-shifting snake that intends to kill her.

title: Panchakshari
desc: After being possessed by Goddess Durga, a devotee predicts her own death. However, the truth of her demise is unravelled when the devotee's look-alike arrives in the village.

title: Deadly Soma
desc: Somasekhara, a bright student, clashes with a gangster's brother post a kabaddi match. This rivalry unexpectedly pulls him into a crime spree.

title: Attahaasa
desc: Veerappan, a poacher, chooses the path of crime and becomes a dangerous criminal. He systematically kills all the policemen who try to stop his evil ways and nab him.
